title: What happened in school, that children started crying bitterly

asr.full_text: Music What does a 4 year old child say? What does a 7 year old sister say? What does an old grandmother say? What do old parents say? Those who want to have their child Those who want to support their child They want to call their child to them She may have to save vegetables in the curry, she sleeps hungry and thirsty, she sleeps after drinking water, but then with energy, a new dawn fights to move her children forward. But at that moment, a young man who is protecting the country, who is standing at the border, but wants to come to the people of the country, he wants to meet his family and children, but he cannot come to protect the country's soldier who was about to return home, the brave son of the country who wanted to meet his children in this Diwali, he was martyred fighting with some terrorists to protect the country. Some terrorists attacked him suddenly, because of which all those soldiers of 24, 25, 28 and 32 years old, who were about to return home in Diwali that today morning they will meet their father. They look at the crowd of people, then they go to the square and tell their mother, Mother, today these people will not meet us, we will celebrate Diwali. Neither mother answers, nor grandmother answers. The mother who wanted to meet her husband is now unconscious. And the father who was waiting for his son was now lying on the floor. Because he saw his old man's stick breaking. That girl says, Mother, I understand. We will never be able to celebrate Deepavali. I understand that you will not be able to tolerate like a bride. I understand that we will not be able to behave like a bride anymore. I understood that we won't be able to hug our father like other kids. We won't be able to call our father. That kid says that he understood that he won't be able to call his father like his friends. I understood that I won't be able to see the old man's stick now. And both brothers and sisters swear. They swear, both brothers and sisters. And swear on that flag. They say that mother is a promise of this flag. It is a promise of this flag. To destroy this terrorism. We brothers and sisters, the work that our father did not do, we will do. It is a promise, mother, of this dead body. The work that our father did not do, we will do what our father has not done! We swear on our grandparents, we will be their stick of evil! We swear on your tears, mother! We will never do something in life because of which your tears will come! Why are your tears coming? Sir... They are coming like this. Did you like the program? Yes, sir. Did you remember anything? Sir, our uncle... Why can't a child who is a SDRR can change? Then why can't the people who are intoxicated with our friends, who are intoxicated with our friends, can they destroy that intoxicating demon? Why can't they imagine their parents' What is the skill of the boat, in which the boat does not get lost, what is the skill of the boat, when the waves do not turn back, when the waves do not turn back. Tell me child, what is your name? Kritika Why are you crying child? Tell me what is your name? My father is also a man. You are an elder and your mother is at home in the village. This is the only place. You are talking to your father. Your father is telling you to study well. You have to study well. Your younger brothers and sisters also have to study well. What message do you want to give? I want to say that we should not get into drugs and should move forward for their country. People don't go to the army, they go to the engineering or the big post. People are saying that they are giving their life. So I would say that people should go to the army and give their life for the country. For the protection of the country. A big round of applause for our little sister. Thank you.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a school-centered news or awareness segment about children grieving a soldier and reflecting on family, loss, and patriotism. The students, reporter interview, and message about avoiding drugs and supporting the country are consistent with an emotional public-message format rather than a financial solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is a general news and human-interest segment about a school event, children, grief, and civic messaging, rather than a financial offer, solicitation, or scam mechanism.
